messages:
release-manager: Heads-up :wave: cutting branch release/1.9 today at 18:00 UTC. Plan: create release/1.9 from main, freeze PRs to that branch except approved cherry-picks. Reply if you need anything included or if you want to own a cherry-pick.
maya: noted — I have a doc fix that should go in. Is backport allowed for docs?
release-manager: docs are fine, please open a PR against release/1.9 after branch is created and tag it with `cherry-pick:docs`. No backport approvals needed for docs.
sam: quick question on policy — for regressions, do we require an approval from the reporter and one maintainer?
release-manager: yes — regressions need QA + a maintainer sign-off. Add label `backport:required` and mention @release-manager in the PR.
chris: I need a cherry-pick for bugfix PR #4287 (null pointer in tokenizer). Can someone run the pick? I can resolve conflicts.
ryan: I can handle the cherry-pick after branch cut. assign to me and I’ll push to release/1.9.
chris: thanks! pinging here so it’s visible. The change touches `tokenizer.py` and `tests/tokenizer_test.py`.
release-manager: reminder: changelog entries must be under `changelog/unreleased.md` and include a short description + PR link. Also bump `pyproject.toml` to 1.9.0-rc.1 in the release branch, not in main.
maya: noted on changelog. I’ll add the doc fix entry after branch is created.
ci-bot: merge-queue: branch release/1.9 created (from main@f3a9b2c). All queued PRs targeting release/1.9 will run CI.
sam: can someone paste the branch cut commands for folks who want to do local picks?
release-manager: sure — run: ```bash
# from main
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.9 origin/main
# create branch remotely
git push -u origin release/1.9
# cherry-pick example
git checkout release/1.9
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
# resolve conflicts, run tests, push
git push origin release/1.9
```
ryan: doing the cherry-pick for #4287 now. I’ll open the PR and add `cherry-pick:approved` label.
chris: much appreciated :thumbsup:
release-manager: final note — cutoff for non-critical changes is 17:30 UTC. After that only security/regressions with approvals. I’ll post a final cutoff reminder 15m before.
maya: copy, thanks for coordinating.
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for release/1.9 branch creation (build, unit, lint).
